title: Region-aware telemetry synchronizer and eviction policy for analytics pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a region-aware synchronizer that controls multi-region replication of console telemetry with an eviction/TTL policy to enforce data residency rules and reduce cross-border data movement. This ticket covers the backend coordination service, fanout buffer design, legal-tag mapping, staleness thresholds, and a safety eviction mechanism for over-quota tenants.
acceptance_criteria: A region synchronizer service exists that reads tenant region intent and legal tags from the tenant registry and annotates outgoing telemetry batches with region metadata.
Replication fanout honors per-tenant residency policy: local-only, multi-region allowlist, or dual-write with masking.
Eviction/TTL policy enforces maximum cross-region retention window; older records are tombstoned or geo-evicted per legal tag mapping.
Pipeline exposes metrics for replication lag, fanout failure rate, and eviction actions; dashboards created in Grafana (console-telemetry/replication).
E2E tests simulate region failover and validate no unauthorized region writes for tenants marked local-only.
Design reviewed and approved by Security & Compliance; any security_review_required flags addressed.
Migration plan for existing mirrored datasets described and tested on staging with rollback steps.
technical_design: Architecture: lightweight synchronizer service (k8s deployment) subscribes to central tenant registry changes, computes a per-tenant replication policy and emits fanout actions into a durable fanout buffer (Kafka topic with region partitions).
Fanout buffer: topic partitioned by tenant_region_key; consumer groups in each region subscribe to their region partitions and apply local writes or mask fields according to legal tags.

Eviction policy: sliding TTL per legal tag + emergency quota eviction that applies when a tenant exceeds cross-region egress budget; eviction action emits an audit event and sets a tombstone marker on downstream stores.
Consistency tiers: strong-local (write-only in origin region), eventual-mirror (best-effort cross-region mirror), and canary-sync (sampled cross-region copies for quality monitoring).
Failure handling: retries with exponential backoff, dead-letter topic, and automatic fallback to a compacted local-only mode if destination region is unreachable for >10m.
Observability: tracing headers propagate tenant intent; metrics: replication_lag_seconds, eviction_count, fanout_errors_total, legal_tag_mismatch_count.
Data model: per-event envelope includes tenant_id, tenant_region_intent, legal_tag_id, origin_region, event_timestamp, sequence_id.
progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Spike complete — validated Kafka partitioning approach and cost trade-offs for cross-region mirrors. Found that dual-write adds ~12% extra egress in test workload.
2026-02-22: Prototype synchronizer service and fanout buffer created in staging. End-to-end write shown for 3 sample tenants with different region intents.
2026-02-25: Security review kickoff — initial questions on encryption of tombstone markers and audit retention answered by S&C team.
2026-03-01: Added emergency eviction flow after tabletop incident re: bursty tenant causing cross-region egress spike during load test.
2026-03-03: Integration tests failing intermittently with fanout ordering — root cause likely consumer partition assignment race; Diego working on consumer rebalance handling.
review_feedback: PM (Lara Gupta): Add a clear customer-facing failure mode summary for Console so customers know when telemetry may be delayed or masked.
Design (Ravi Patel): Ensure the masking rules for PII fields are configurable per legal tag; provide a default safe-mask policy.
Security (Tara Singh): Require KMS-wrapped tombstone markers and include HMAC of tenant_id in audit events to prevent tampering.
Infra (Owen Baker): Suggest using regional Kafka clusters with MirrorMaker2 only for mirror tier; avoid cross-region Kafka replication for strong-local tier.
comments: Diego: Need to finalize SLAs for eviction actions and whether customers get notified through the Console when emergency evictions occur.
Maya: Proposed migration job to backfill legal tags for tenants created before legal-tag rollout — waiting on registry API change (ENG-20448).
QA: Add chaos test that kills regional consumers to validate fallback to local-only mode and ensure no cross-region writes happen.
